rows.grounds: śivaśaktitayābhyarcyau = to-be-worshipped-as-shiva-and-shakti; compound śiva-śakti-tayā + abhyarcya, nominative dual masculine
tathetthaṃ = and-thus-in-this-way; sandhi of tathā + ittham, both indeclinables
saṃskriyānayoḥ = of-the-consecration-of-these-two; genitive dual feminine of saṃskriyā

tattvasaṃdarśanānnānyatsaṃskārasyāsti = from-seeing-the-principle-no-other-of-consecration-exists; sandhi/compound chain: tattva-saṃdarśanāt (abl.sg.nt) + na + anyat (n.nom.sg) + saṃskārasya (m.gen.sg) + asti (3sg.pres.act √as)
jīvitam = life-force; nominative singular neuter of jīvita
